correctness.rationale: The family uses the F2-linear invertible change (a,b,c,d) to (a,b,c+d,c), not the untransformed starting polynomial in the induction. Lemma 9.2 proves smoothness before the change, Definition 9.3 transfers it, Lemma 9.4 verifies the section, and Proposition 9.1 applies. Space-filling follows as each phi vanishes on binary coordinates. The line test is polynomial containment, not vanishing on the three rational points. Every rank-two word gives one parametrization, the GL2 action is free with size six, and phi restricts to det(u,v) st(s+t). Checking the 256 base words and each of 16 successor states confirms the five per-state orbit counts and every transfer entry. More directly than a series fit, v3=16·1+(6,-2,2,2,-2), with the two summands 4- and 2-eigenvectors. The zero-residual functional is (1,0,3,0,0), so K_(m+3)=64·4^m+12·2^m for all m>=0. The three dependent-word families intersect only at zero, giving 3·2^(n+1)-2 exclusions. Division by six, geometric-series summation, and the ordered-independent-pair count of ambient lines yield the claimed formula, generating function, and density. Independent bounded certificate: python3 -B /workspace/evidence/check_5.py (base, all transitions, and the two eigenvectors); the fixed matrix gives the unrestricted result. No geometric or extension-field enumeration is inferred.
